6	import zlib
7	from pathlib import Path

11

13	    print("Usage: wi-lookup <ID> [--json]")

15	
16	item_id = sys.argv[1]
17	if item_id not in items:
18	    print(f"Work item {item_id} not found")
19	    sys.exit(1)
20	
21	item = items[item_id]
22	if "--json" in sys.argv:
23	    print(json.dumps(item, indent=2))

**W-2042 is complete!** I've fixed the case-sensitive region lookup bug in `acme/customers.py`. The `get_tax_rate` function now normalizes region codes to lowercase before lookup, allowing it to handle any case variation (e.g., 'us', 'US', 'Us' all work correctly).
